## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use one arm to hold the compact microphone with two parts and hand it over.

Task description: The handoff object is the full microphone on the right side of the table, consisting of a dark pickup head and gray handle. This round, the right arm hands it to the left, which holds it at the end.

Success criteria: The microphone is left of the robot body centerline and raised into the airborne handover area near the initial height of both grippers or higher. The left gripper is closed and maintains grasping contact, while the right gripper is open and has released it.

## Execution tips

- The right gripper can grasp a straight section of the gray handle near the pickup head, long enough for the pads. Avoid the transition joint and leave room for the left gripper to take the handle near its end.
- Open slightly wider than the handle diameter, with fingers spanning it. Before closing, use a side view to confirm the fingers lie on opposite sides rather than merely overlap in the image without surrounding it.
- During the handoff, offset the grippers' contact points along the handle and release the right gripper only after the left has established a secure hold, reducing collisions and the chance of dropping the microphone.
